comments.content: New HashSet-based dedup logic is not exercised by this test — three identical titles are handled identically by both the old greedy-counter code and the new code. The new logic specifically defends against adversarial input where existing titles already contain "（N）" suffixes (per the comment "贪心计数会把 '审阅（2）' 撞成两份"). Add a regression test like `["审阅", "审阅", "审阅（2）"]` to actually exercise the collision-avoidance path.

The new `MAX_GUIDANCE_CHARS` server-side check is untested. Add a boundary test (e.g., `MAX_GUIDANCE_CHARS` chars rejected, `MAX_GUIDANCE_CHARS - 1` accepted) to lock the limit and catch regressions if the constant is bumped.

The `chars().take(200).collect()` here bypasses the canonical `escape_for_log(v, KV_VALUE_MAX)` pipeline that the rest of `audit::write_event` callers rely on — values are re-escaped and truncated inside `append_kv_escaped`, so this pre-truncation is both redundant (wasteful — string is clipped twice) and inconsistent (no `…` ellipsis, magic literal `200` vs the shared `KV_VALUE_MAX = 500`). Pass `last_err` directly and let the audit layer handle escaping + truncation uniformly.

`nameAuto` is a component-level flag tracking whether the current workflow's name is still the auto-generated default. It's set to `false` only when the user types into the GoalNode input (via `onRename`). However, neither `createBlank` nor `openWorkflow` resets it, so the flag leaks across workflow contexts.

Repro:
1. Hero state → type goal → click AI 生成 → name set to goal prefix, `nameAuto=true`
2. User renames via input → `nameAuto=false`
3. User clicks 新建 (or deletes) → `createBlank` → name becomes "工作流 ${today}", but `nameAuto` is still `false`
4. User types a new goal, clicks AI 生成 → decompose succeeds, but the `if (nameAuto)` guard skips `setName`, so the new blank workflow keeps the stale default name instead of being auto-named from the goal

Same issue applies when switching between workflows: after renaming workflow A and opening workflow B from the dropdown, `nameAuto` carries over as `false`, so a subsequent AI 重新生成 won't update B's loaded name from DB based on the new goal prefix.

Fix: add `setNameAuto(true)` after the `setRegenArmed(false)` in `createBlank` (and consider the same in `openWorkflow`, where the loaded name from DB is conceptually "user's saved choice" — pick one semantics and reset consistently at every workflow-context transition).

Inconsistent state cleanup: `openWorkflow` (line 145) and `createBlank` (line 154) both call `setRegenArmed(false)` when switching workflows, but `addNode` does not. If a user has clicked the regenerate button once (`regenArmed=true`, 3s timer running) and then clicks addNode, the armed state persists — a subsequent click on the regenerate button within the 3s window will trigger the confirmation step and switch to hero mode, abandoning the user's just-added node and any other pending edits. `addNode` should reset `regenArmed` for the same reason it cancels in-flight decompose: the user is choosing to edit manually, which contradicts the regenerate intent.

comments.content: 重名加后缀的循环用了已被前一轮 `st.title = format!("{base}（{n}）")` 改写过的 `st.title` 当 base，导致「连续三次相同 title」的实际结果不是测试期望的 `["审阅", "审阅（2）", "审阅（3）"]` 而是 `["审阅", "审阅（2）", "审阅（2）（2）"]`（第三次迭代 `used.insert("审阅（2）")` 返回 false，`base = "审阅（2）"`，于是撞出 `审阅（2）（2）`）。这同时是 confirmed-finding #1 提到的「未覆盖连续重复」的实际成因：原作者期望 `["审阅","审阅","审阅"]` 产出递增后缀，但 `iter_mut()` 把 `st.title` 写进去后下一轮就读到的是改写后的值。修复方向：循环外先 `let originals: Vec<String> = subtasks.iter().map(|s| s.title.clone()).collect();`，循环里用 `originals[i]` 而不是 `st.title` 做 base（同时 base 也得是 `originals[i]`），这样第三次会得到 `审阅（3）`，且原 adversarial 输入 `["审阅","审阅","审阅（2）"]` 走到的还是「第一/二个 `审阅`/`审阅（2）`、第三个 `审阅（2）` 在 used 里、再撞 `审阅（2）（2）`」这条路径不被回退。

失败审计只覆盖「校验链兜不住」这一种失败模式：注释声称「成功/失败都该可回查」，但 `summarize_messages(...).await?`（本行上方）把 LLM 调用本身的失败（`LlmRequestFailed` / `LlmApiError` / `ApiKeyMissing` / `BotDisabled` 等）用 `?` 直接外抛，整段函数 early-return 出去，下面的 `crate::audit::write_event(... "outcome=failed")` 根本走不到——比如此时 bot.log 里只会看到前端 toast，看不到任何 `workflow_decompose` 审计事件，排障「拆解为什么失败」会两眼一抹黑。建议改写成 `match summarize_messages(...).await { Ok(raw) => ..., Err(e) => { 记失败审计; return Err(e); } }`，或在外面套一层 `let raw = ...;` 之后再处理。
